title: Small Compiler Subset Plain-English Error Contract
purpose: Lock stable, plain-English, creator-facing error records for invalid small compiler subset examples before the self-hosting bridge carries more compiler weight.

allowed: adding a non-production small compiler subset error contract
canonicalizing existing parser and emitter diagnostics into stable error IDs
locking plain-English messages for invalid small compiler subset examples
preserving valid small compiler subset IR golden parity from v0.1.51
forbidden_until_later_approval: routing normal BASIC# compilation through the small compiler subset
retiring Ruby as production compiler or referee

error_record_schema.line_number: 1-based source line number where BASIC# can point the creator
error_record_schema.source_message: current underlying parser or emitter diagnostic used as the Ruby-referee source

expected_errors.plain_message: This Body is missing its closing ]. line.
expected_errors.source_message: START Body is missing its End ].

expected_errors.plain_message: This Body closes with ], but BASIC# needs ]. to finish the Body.

fixtures.name: when_missing_then_marker
fixtures.source:
WHEN the player opens the door
[
    (change @door to open
].

expected_errors.plain_message: Every WHEN instruction inside the Body must begin with |then.
expected_errors.source_message: Every WHEN Body instruction must begin with |then

expected_errors.plain_message: This Body needs at least one |then instruction followed by an official word.
expected_errors.source_message: WHEN needs at least one |then followed by an official word

fixtures.name: if_missing_official_word
fixtures.source:
IF the player enters the room
[
    |then change @door to locked
].

expected_errors.plain_message: After |then, use an official word that starts with (, such as (damage.
expected_errors.source_message: Result must be followed by an official word such as (damage

expected_errors.plain_message: OTHERWISE must come immediately after the IF Body it belongs to.
expected_errors.source_message: OTHERWISE must directly follow the IF Body it belongs to.

expected_errors.plain_message: A Kind line must look like #dragon is a #creature.
expected_errors.source_message: Kind must look like '#dragon is a #creature'

acceptance_rules: Every fixture must match its locked error IDs, line numbers, severities, plain messages, source messages, and digest.
The error contract must not change valid subset IR output or golden IR parity.
The error contract tool must pass inside the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
No Profile 8, new syntax, runtime change, bytecode change, web export, browser work, engine bridge, or Ruby retirement is allowed.
